headline: Load spike and sleep debt — today's session is already done, so the job now is rest.
body_state: Readiness sits at 43.6 (moderate band), driven by sleep — Garmin's own composite reads 35 ("Unproductive"). Sleep score 58, only 5.8h last night, and 22h of 14-day sleep debt built up. Body Battery is 39 — under the 40 line where quality work stops paying off. HRV last night was 38ms, down from the 44–47ms Balanced readings earlier this week. ACWR is 1.67, a red load spike (2–4× injury risk territory this week). TSB (-18) is technically your productive-building zone, but every recovery signal is red at once — that overrides it today.
session: Today's plan called for cross-training, and you already did it this morning: 44.8min of indoor cardio at avg HR 119 — the lightest of your last four cardio sessions (119 vs 141, 141, 130 on the prior three). That was the right call given this morning's readiness. One thing worth noting: recovery windows between surges shrank late in the session (dips only fell to 110–140bpm in the back half vs 50–70bpm early) — fatigue was building even at this lighter intensity. Nothing else is scheduled today. Treat the rest of the day as genuinely off — no bonus cardio class tonight.
recent: Four cardio sessions in five days (Aug 4, Aug 5 twice, Aug 6), two of them RPE 8 and stacked on days that already had planned work — Aug 5 paired a clean 07:50 easy run (4:32/km at 67% max HR, genuinely easy despite a self-rated RPE 6) with an unplanned RPE-8 evening class the same day. That's the pattern behind the #1 ranked limiter, grey-zone training: those classes are running 75–77% Zone 3/4, not true easy, pulling the week further from the ~80%-easy target instead of closing the gap. Aug 2's long run and Aug 3's easy-with-strides were both missed (red).
focus: Stop stacking unplanned hard cardio onto days that already have scheduled work — let one carry the load, not both.
Sleep is the driver tonight: 22h of debt built up, earlier bedtime, nothing else logged today.
Sunday's progressive long run (Aug 9) only gets the progression if readiness climbs off the floor by Saturday night — otherwise run it flat and easy.
